title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM
You can select individual unpaid items by business partner, contract account, document, or net due date, and set them manually
for a collection order. You can also manually reset releases that have already been made for collection for individual items of a
business partner.

Activities
To release items for collection:

1. In the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |sAccount » Submit to Collections » Release Items for Collection (transaction
FPO3E).

2. Enter the criteria that you want to use to select the items to be submitted.

If you select the Only Items to Be Submitted indicator, the system displays only those items that you have not yet
submitted to a collection agency. If you set the Written Off Items indicator, the items of a business partner that have
already been written off are also offered for release for collection.

3. Choose Continue.

4. Select the items that you want to release for collection and choose |Edit » Hold for Collection Order

As aresult, you have released the items for submission. Via|#Items » Refresh = you can update the display. This means that the
released receivables are no longer displayed. Via |-ltems Other Receivables “jyou can select new items.

To reset the release:

1. In the transaction Release Items for Collection, select the required items.
2. In the menu, choose |Edit » Reset Release

3. Save your entry.

Automatic Release

Use

Using the mass run Release for Collection is recommended if you are processing large volumes of data.

Activities

1. In the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |sPeriodic Processing For Contract Accounts » Submission for Collection
Release Run 3 (transaction FPQ3M).

2. Assign a date ID and an identification that you can use to identify the run later and on the General Selections tab, restrict
the selection of the receivables to be released. On the Additional Selection tab, you can refine this search using additional
criteria and also include statistical and written off items in the selection. You can also restrict the selection using a run
variant according to your company-specific requirements (see also the documentation for the field Execution Variant and

the section Releasing Receivables for Collection).

3. Choose whether you want to start a simulation run or actually release the receivables.
